raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With rollout routing replay (R3) and `pause_generation_mode=retract`, a weight update retracts running requests. `reset_for_retract` drops their KV cache and `routed_experts`, and the resumed request re-prefills `origin_input_ids + output_ids` under the new weights. The routed-experts capturer stores rows per KV slot, so the re-prefill overwrites the routing of already-generated tokens, while their logprobs still come from the original decode under the old weights and the old routing. The trainer then replays routing that did not produce those logprobs.

On GLM-5.3-Flash fully-async RL this was the difference between a trainer-vs-rollout logprob abs diff of about 0.05 and about 0.018 at the same staleness. The same gap showed up on MI355X and on MI300X.

#43966 fixes the same bug unconditionally, with a broader history helper and tests. This PR is the opt-in version that those RL runs used. It stays off unless `SGLANG_R3_KEEP_ROUTING_ON_RETRACT=1`.

## Modifications

When the flag is set:

- `release_req` snapshots the request's captured routing rows before its KV cache is released, and merges them with rows kept by earlier retracts. Requests that do not ask for routed experts are skipped. `input_embeds` retraction discards `output_ids` and restarts generation, so that path drops any kept rows instead of restoring them onto a new sequence.
- After the final routed experts are collected, the kept rows overwrite the re-prefilled rows for the tokens they cover. Every 64 restored requests the server logs the fraction of `(token, MoE layer)` expert sets the re-prefill changed, as `[r3-keep-routing] restored ...`.

## Accuracy Tests

GLM-5.3-Flash fully-async RL:

| | `train_rollout_logprob_abs_diff` |
|---|---|
| Retract without this flag | about 0.05 |
| `SGLANG_R3_KEEP_ROUTING_ON_RETRACT=1` | about 0.018 |

On MI300X with the flag, the gap over 4 steps was 0.022–0.029, in the same range as the previous build's R3 runs (0.017–0.037).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The snapshot is one host gather of the request's captured rows at retraction, and one overwrite at response assembly. Rollout step time on the MI300X R3 run stayed in the same 114–157 s range as the run without R3.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

         batch.mamba_track_indices[freed_rows] = -1
 
 
+def _r3_keep_routing_before_release(req: Req, req_to_token_pool) -> None:
+    """Copy captured routing for computed positions to host before KV is freed.
+
+    Active only when SGLANG_R3_KEEP_ROUTING_ON_RETRACT=1. The snapshot is merged
+    with rows kept by earlier retracts of the same request.
+    """
+    if not envs.SGLANG_R3_KEEP_ROUTING_ON_RETRACT.get():
+        return
+    if not req.return_routed_experts or req.kv.req_pool_idx is None:
+        return
+    # input_embeds retraction discards output_ids and restarts generation, so
+    # the previous routing no longer belongs to the request.
+    if req.input_embeds is not None:
+        req.r3_kept_routed_experts = None
+        return
+
+    from sglang.srt.state_capturer.routed_experts import get_global_experts_capturer
+
+    capturer = get_global_experts_capturer()
+    if capturer is None:
+        return
+    # Positions [0, n) have been forwarded: the last sampled token has no KV
+    # yet, and a retracted chunked prefill has only computed up to
+    # kv_committed_len.
+    n = min(
+        len(req.origin_input_ids) + len(req.output_ids) - 1,
+        req.kv.kv_committed_len,
+    )
+    kept = getattr(req, "r3_kept_routed_experts", None)
+    if n <= (0 if kept is None else kept.shape[0]):
+        return
+    rows = capturer.get_topk(
+        req_pool_idx=req.kv.req_pool_idx,
+        seqlen=n + 1,
+        req_to_token_pool=req_to_token_pool,
+    ).clone()
+    if kept is not None:
+        rows[: kept.shape[0]] = kept
+    req.r3_kept_routed_experts = rows
+
+

 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
+_R3_RESTORE_STATS = {"reqs": 0, "rows": 0, "pairs": 0, "changed": 0}

+def _r3_restore_kept_routing(req, start_len: int) -> None:
+    """Overwrite re-prefill routing rows with the rows kept at retraction time."""
+    kept = getattr(req, "r3_kept_routed_experts", None)
+    if kept is None:
+        return
+    req.r3_kept_routed_experts = None
+    if req.routed_experts is None:
+        return
+    n = min(kept.shape[0], start_len + req.routed_experts.shape[0])
+    if n <= start_len:
+        return
+    old = kept[start_len:n]
+    cur = req.routed_experts[: n - start_len]
+    # Layers that route; dense / non-MoE rows are all zero.
+    moe = old.ne(0).any(dim=-1)
+    changed = old.sort(dim=-1).values.ne(cur.sort(dim=-1).values).any(dim=-1) & moe
+    req.routed_experts[: n - start_len] = old
+    stats = _R3_RESTORE_STATS
+    stats["reqs"] += 1
+    stats["rows"] += n - start_len
+    stats["pairs"] += int(moe.sum())
+    stats["changed"] += int(changed.sum())
+    if stats["reqs"] % 64 == 1:
+        logger.info(
+            "[r3-keep-routing] restored %d reqs, %d token rows; "
+            "re-prefill changed %.4f of (token, MoE layer) expert sets",
+            stats["reqs"],
+            stats["rows"],
+            stats["changed"] / max(1, stats["pairs"]),
+        )
